steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Enter the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 requested units to Vendor B.
Verify the full 10-unit allocation to Vendor B at 90 per unit totals 900 and only one of two bidders is awarded.
Create the award proposal from the completed allocation.
Verify that the proposal page opened.
Open the Document tab.
Verify the Document tab content is shown.
Open the Overview tab.
Verify the Overview tab is active and rendered.
Open the allocation summary.
Verify Vendor B appears in the allocation summary.
Verify the summary shows the 10 allocated items.
Open the comparison sheets tab.
Verify the comparison sheets show the Master QCS data.
Open the proposal participants tab.
Verify the other bidder is listed among participants.
Verify the awarded vendor is listed among participants.
Open the order allocation tab.
Verify the order allocation view is rendered.
